name: workflow-automation-engine
description: Multi-tenant backend engine that executes multi-step workflows defined as DAGs with HTTP triggers, conditional branching, and retry logic.

tools.name: register_tenant
tools.description: Create a new tenant and issue an API key (POST /api/tenants/register)

tools.name: create_workflow
tools.description: Create a workflow from a DAG definition (POST /api/workflows)

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List workflows for the authenticated tenant (GET /api/workflows)

tools.name: stream_execution
tools.description: SSE stream of step status updates (GET /api/executions/{id}/stream)

tools.name: replay_execution
tools.description: Replay an execution with original or modified trigger data (POST /api/executions/{id}/replay)

tools.name: get_execution_logs
tools.description: Fetch structured logs for an execution (GET /api/executions/{id}/logs)
